title: Clawback
key_points: Clawback transactions allow an account to reclaim previously transferred XRP or drops.
The clawback action can be applied to any transaction type that transfers XRP or drops.
A clawback requires the signer and submitter fields to include the original sender's account.
If a clawed drop is not claimed within 10 days, it reverts to the clawback-enabled account.
limitations: The scope of this document does not cover all potential use cases or edge cases for clawback transactions.
asserts: Clawback transactions enable an account to reclaim previously transferred XRP or drops by specifying a target transaction and the sender's account in the signer and submitter fields.
